text.p: These are the leading stories in the Moroccan press on Wednesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Jordan's King Hussein on a working visit to Morocco.
- Interior ministry starts discussing project to hand over Rabat distribution of water and electricity to Spanish-Portuguese consortium.
- Fisheries ministry launches site on Internet to provide overall information on the sector.
- Morocco and Spain started installing high tension cable to connect the two countries electricity grids.
- Morocco and Jordan examine ways to boost the peace process in the Middle East.
